title: Replace hardcoded hex Color literals with AppColors tokens in notifications UI
why: Both files already import and correctly use AppColors/AppTheme for some colors, so the raw hex values are avoidable inconsistency, not a missing token system. A future theme change (dark mode, rebrand) requires hunting these two files for magic hex values instead of touching one theme file, and this violates the (currently non-enforcing, due to the custom_lint breakage) no_color_literal_outside_theme rule.
recommendation: Promote the repeated literals to named AppColors tokens and reference those instead of inline Color(0x...) values.
acceptance_criteria: Once custom_lint is fixed (tracked separately), dart run custom_lint reports zero no_color_literal_outside_theme hits in lib/features/notifications/.

corrections: Claim 'both files already...correctly use AppColors' is false for device_notification_toggle.dart — it imports no theme tokens whatsoever (checked); only notifications_screen.dart mixes AppColors/AppTheme with raw hex as described.
